svg.text: Waypoints, offsets and log lines are taken from move_to_pose.cpp. Object positions are an example; time is compressed.
x forward (up), y to the left; straight lines = Cartesian paths
shaded: camera field of view on the table (example intrinsics)
schematic links; TCP height is exact
open gripper to 8 cm, then 1 s
